description: Make an API key for a server, an agent or a CI job. The answer has `key`, shown this once: put it straight where it will live (a secret store, an environment variable) and keep it out of chat, logs and files. Access is read, draft (writes drafts a person approves, never sends), send or admin, and never more than your own; a test key makes only test keys. Give the narrowest that works. Needs the Everything level, of the whole account.

access.description: What it may do; read when left out.

name.description: Where the key will live, e.g. "support agent".

test.description: A test key: its mail never leaves Pidgeon.
